title: Agent workload in project dashboard output
description: Extend the project dashboard output to include agent workload statistics. For each agent identity in the project, compute: total runs assigned, stages completed, currently active runs. Add a workload_by_role summary to the dashboard output with runs_per_role and stages_per_role counts. Update the dashboard schema to include the new fields.
stop_condition: The project dashboard output includes workload counts per role. The schema validates the new fields.
